panels.title: ¿La caldera o la biomasa están bajando el rendimiento?

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "asset_risk" and r.equipment == "CalderaBiomasa01" and r._field == "risk_score") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "asset_risk" and r.equipment == "SistemaBiomasa" and r._field == "risk_score") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "asset_risk" and r.equipment == "CombustionCaldera" and r._field == "risk_score") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "costo_biomasa_por_mwh" and r._field == "value") |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.variable == "TemperaturaEscape" or r.variable == "PresionDiferencial") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["variable", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.variable == "PotenciaMW" or r.variable == "ConsumoBiomasa") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["variable", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Potencia generada vs consumo de biomasa

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and r.variable == "HumedadBiomasa" and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["variable", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "energia_por_ton_biomasa" and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["kpi", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Humedad biomasa vs energía por tonelada

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.variable == "CO" or r.variable == "O2") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["variable", "unit"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_event") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "fouling_caldera" or r.type == "humedad_biomasa_alta" or r.type == "combustion_inestable") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "type", "score", "message", "probable_cause"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "maintenance_recommendation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.equipment == "CalderaBiomasa01" or r.equipment == "SistemaBiomasa" or r.equipment == "CombustionCaldera") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "suggested_action", "due_minutes", "expected_impact", "ack_status"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
